stock.description: Solargiga Energy Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding firm with core activities encompassing the production, refinement, and commercialization of polysilicon and monocrystalline silicon solar ingots and wafers throughout Mainland China. The company's operations also extend to fabricating and distributing monocrystalline silicon solar cells and photovoltaic modules. Beyond manufacturing, it undertakes the deployment of photovoltaic systems and the construction and operation of solar power facilities. An additional business segment involves the creation and sale of electronic semiconductor materials. Solargiga serves a clientele primarily consisting of manufacturers and traders specializing in silicon solar wafers, cells, or modules. Its offerings are exported globally, reaching markets in Japan, South Asia, Europe, and beyond. Founded in 2001, the company maintains its principal office in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
